name: Tom Evans
quality: small; cropped from a group photograph at the native resolution of the digitised page, no upscaling
why: Executive Committee photograph on p. 154 of the 1968 Talisman, the left-hand page of the Associated Students committee spread. The caption names seven and exactly seven people stand in one straight line, so the names map one to one. Evans is named fifth and is the fifth person from the left. The left-to-right reading is proved by this caption itself rather than assumed: the two women are named third and fourth, and the line runs man, man, woman, woman, man, man, man, which a right-to-left reading would put at positions four and five. The same page spread carries Rules and Elections (man, woman, man) and Student Activities (woman, man, man, woman), both consistent. This archive already publishes Susan Streible from the fourth position of this same line.
caption_quote: EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE—Larry Heishman, Bill Straeffer, Claudia Fowler, Susan Streible, Tom Evans, William Menser, Ron Beck.

name: Paul Gerard
quality: small; cropped from a group photograph at the native resolution of the digitised page, no upscaling
why: Rules and Elections Committee photograph on p. 155 of the 1968 Talisman. The caption names three, three people stand in one line, and their sexes run man, woman, man exactly as Gerard, Garrison and Adams are listed. Gerard is named first and is the man at the left-hand edge. The left-to-right reading of this spread is proved on its own left-hand page: the Executive Committee caption names Larry Heishman, Bill Straeffer, Claudia Fowler, Susan Streible, Tom Evans, William Menser, Ron Beck against seven people in one line running man, man, woman, woman, man, man, man, which puts the two named women third and fourth exactly as printed and rules out a right-to-left reading, which would put them fourth and fifth. The face is consistent with the Paul Gerard portrait this archive already publishes, a dark-haired man with a long face; that portrait is filed under Paul Gerard, III, and this finding does not merge the two records.
caption_quote: RULES AND ELECTIONS COMMITTEE—Paul Gerard, Pat Garrison, John Adams.
